paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: The effect of context masking on case tasks groupby by language family. Error bars indicate the standard deviation.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the effect of context masking on case tasks, grouped by language family. The horizontal axis represents language families, ordered as IE-Indic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis, labeled "effect," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick labels displayed at intervals of 5. Three distinct datasets, mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, and mBERT-B2, are represented by bars of different colors: mBERT-L2 in light green, XLM-L2 in light blue, and mBERT-B2 in red. Error bars, representing standard deviation, are displayed for each bar. The bars are grouped by language family, with each language family having three bars corresponding to each dataset. For instance, the IE-Indic language family has three bars, one light green at an approximate value of 3, one light blue at approximately 4, and one red at approximately 2. The tallest bars observed are within the IE-Romance family, with the mBERT-B2 bar reaching an approximate value of 25, while the shortest bars are within the Uralic family, with the XLM-L2 bar exhibiting a value of approximately 1. No bars are visually emphasized.
